# 821. Shortest Distance to a Character

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def shortestToChar(self, s, c):
        """
        :type s: str
        :type c: str
        :rtype: List[int]
        """
        n = len(s)
        ans = [0 for _ in range(n)]
        cur_idx = -n
        for i in range(n):
            if s[i] == c:
                cur_idx = i
            ans[i] = i - cur_idx
        cur_idx = 2 * n
        for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
            if s[i] == c:
                cur_idx = i
            ans[i] = min(ans[i], cur_idx - i)
        return ans
```
